preregistration.hypothesis: Retain typed observed face-down orientation and actual public takeability witnesses across retries. In the depth4/beam6 lookahead, allow a covered remembered tile only after all removals in a real earlier availability witness are also removed in the hypothetical state, and preserve any required relief flag. This monotone subset proof works with stacked/arbitrary obstacle counts; it never infers a fictitious initial role. Current code refuses to simulate a previously known covered key because seen.down/roles are null even after a simulated repeat of its actually observed access route. Keep the previous picture relations/goal work strategy to test their interaction.
preregistration.evidence: Factory computeTrayHorizon stepMove rejects seen.down=null and isFreeAndUsable rejects hidden roles even when an earlier real try demonstrated the same removed-set access. Production keeps an alive tile face-down until taken; peeks use openPeek and do not permanently change down.
preregistration.validation: Physical key-access counterexample with remembered down flag and proven availability, restored-prerequisite/relief negative proofs, fresh-choice parity, unchanged observer masks, independent production replay; full test suite and M1/M2 before all15 lab boards
preregistration.progressRule: Retain all previous M1/M2 gates. M3 progress requires the number of complete20/20-clear boards to increase against the retained best anchor (strictly greater, not an equal-count swap), or an already-complete primary rank to improve by>=.05. Valid full coverage and all15 targets required. Invalid/regressed runs cannot count. All histories retained.
preregistration.preExecutionClarification: When the new access proof enables removal of a remembered key in lookahead, use its already observed static key membership for unlock bookkeeping even if its current overlay is hidden. Never rewrite that hidden starting overlay.

nextProposedExperiment.hypothesis: After actual earlier losses, discourage repeated inspection of an already-known closed tile in the identical alive/tray state when it neither matches the tray nor an open/available partner. Preserve the first inspection and every immediate matching continuation. This targets unproductive oscillation, not a per-level route or fitted attempt count.
